model_family: Three precommitted Gaussian-copula latent-factor dependence completions with common normal log10-leptin and lognormal positive raw-scale marginals

evidence_use.operator: arithmetic means and sample SDs on complete endpoint pairs
evidence_use.population: 44 completers aged 7-14 with simple obesity; before/after 3-month home diet/exercise program with professional follow-up; no randomized parallel arm; 43 glucose and triglyceride pairs.
evidence_use.measurement: units specified per endpoint; pediatric leptin already log10(pg/mL)
evidence_use.reason: Use all rounded complete-pair arithmetic means and sample SDs as plug-in marginal distribution parameters. Transform positive endpoints to lognormal log-location/log-scale; leptin remains on its supplied log10 scale. These target-derived A0 reconstruction inputs do not validate dependence or clinical findings. Do not fit finite-sample moments or inferred change statistics.

evidence_use.population: 44 completers aged 7-14 with simple obesity; before/after 3-month home diet/exercise program with professional follow-up; no randomized parallel arm; 43 glucose and triglyceride pairs.
evidence_use.reason: Use one row per completer and pre/post pairing, with 44 leptin/body-mass and 43 glucose/triglyceride pairs at n=44. Generalize counts as round(source_count*n/44). Both-null trailing fields and co-placement are schema storage conventions, not claims about native missingness. No control arm, age distribution or unreported measurement is invented.

components.name: common arithmetic marginal reconstruction
components.source_to_target_assumptions: Source moments parameterize same-population distributions: normal on log10 leptin; log_variance=log(1+(sd/mean)^2) and log_mean=log(mean)-log_variance/2 for lognormal raw endpoints. Finite sample moments fluctuate. No recentering, optimization, truncation, or fit to target findings.

components.name: stable person, stable endpoint, shared visit and residual latent components
components.source_to_target_assumptions: Independent standard-normal factors have nonnegative scenario-specific variance shares summing to one. Person and endpoint factors persist across visits; visit factors are independent across visits and shared across endpoints. All share values are explicit sensitivity assumptions, not source estimates. Marginal transforms can alter raw-scale correlation and change dependence.

components.name: paired support and identifiers
components.source_to_target_assumptions: New unique synthetic identifiers per cohort; schema column order; fixed n persons; positive lognormal support; paired-null trailing rows with source count scaling. At n=44 final row has unavailable glucose and triglyceride pairs. No missingness mechanism is estimated.
